The Recently Updated feed only lets me get to page 2: page 2 has no Next link, even though far more series were updated recently (I added a batch of 80+ series this week).

Current behaviour:
Recently Updated shows 20 series per page. Page 1 has a Next link, page 2 has none. If I edit the URL by hand to pageNumber=3, more series do come back.

Expected behaviour:
I can keep paging through all recently updated series from the reader app.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Turn on OPDS and add your OPDS URL to any OPDS reader.
2. Have more than 40 series with new chapters added recently.
3. Open Recently Updated and go to page 2.
4.
